comparisons.name: window-light
comparisons.description: The scene of the Aqua capture: the Messages window, inactive, behind its key Preferences window, from the Preferences window's left edge to the Messages window's right edge. Whole crop: the desktop picture left of the Messages window is a flat stand-in colour; the conversation list, whose material is vibrant in the capture, is the opaque surface in the tint measured over the first conversation, flat where the picture shades the capture's from beige to blue-grey; the selected row is its measured mean, flat; every glyph is a stand-in drawing, and the contact's picture, the Preferences icons and the folder are abstract placeholders in one grey; the person is invented, where the capture's name is blurred out; and the text is set in the fallback font. Four masks leave the abstract placeholders out, as they depict nothing: the disc of the contact's picture, the two icons of the Preferences toolbar (the items' labels and the selection around the first are scored), and the square before the folder's title.

comparisons.name: window-light-layout
comparisons.description: As window-light with the desktop picture, what it tints, the text and the stand-in artwork masked: the two rectangles of desktop left of the Messages window, over and under the Preferences window; the part of the list under the Preferences window, with the divider beside it, where the picture turns the capture's list blue-grey; the search field's glass and placeholder; the compose glyph; the whole placeholder disc of the contact's picture; the row's name, time and last message; To: with the name, and Details; the transcript's header, the text of the sent bubble, the received bubble with its text (the fallback font makes it 2.5 pt wider) and Delivered; the placeholder and the two glyphs of the message field's bar; and in the Preferences window the title, the toolbar's icons (placeholders) and labels, the form's labels, the titles of the pop-up buttons, with the placeholder square before the folder's, and of the checkboxes, and the two letters over the slider. That leaves the two window frames and their shadows, the list's surface with the window controls, the search field, the compose button's bezel (the library's compact push button, whose corners are less round than the capture's), the rule and the selected row around the placeholder, the divider, both bars and their rules, the transcript with the sent bubble's outline and tail, the message field's bezel (the library's capsule text field), and the Preferences window's title bar, toolbar selection, pop-up button bezels, checkboxes, slider and help button.

comparisons.name: window-dark
comparisons.description: The scene of the Dark Aqua capture, taken a day later (the times read Yesterday): the Messages window, inactive, behind its key Preferences window, which stands 39 pt higher than in the Aqua capture and covers the lower part of the selected conversation. Whole crop, with the same stand-ins as window-light: a flat colour for the desktop picture, the opaque list in its measured tint, stand-in glyphs, placeholders for the picture and the icons, an invented person and the fallback font. The same four masks leave the placeholders out: the part of the picture's disc that shows over the Preferences window, the toolbar's two icons and the square before the folder's title.

comparisons.name: window-dark-layout
comparisons.description: As window-dark with the same regions masked as window-light-layout, where the Dark Aqua scene has them, except the list under the Preferences window: the dark desktop picture tints the list evenly, so all of it is scored.

comparisons.name: send-light
comparisons.description: Sending, which no screenshot shows, Aqua: a real click in the message field of the scene, the keys H and i, and Return. Eight pixels say that a message was sent and where it went: a sent iMessage bubble, two letters wide, stands at the trailing edge under what was the transcript's last bubble, nothing stands at the leading edge beside it or under it, the status has left the first bubble, and the click made the Messages window key and the Preferences window inactive. Without the Return, or with the message put anywhere else, the first two pixels are the transcript's background. Pixels cannot show which conversation the bubble belongs to (the scene has the capture's one), that its text is what was typed, that the field was emptied or that the row's last message changed: messages.browser.test.tsx reads those in Chromium, with five conversations.

pixels.note: top of the new bubble, 4.5 pt inside its trailing edge: the top of the iMessage gradient (--mac-message-bubble-imessage-fill-top, measured). The bubble starts 8 pt under the received one, which moved up to where the status was; inferred
bottom of the new bubble, 14 pt lower: the bottom of the iMessage gradient (--mac-message-bubble-imessage-fill-bottom, measured)

46 pt inside the trailing edge at the new bubble's middle: the transcript's background (--mac-message-bubble-transcript-background, measured), since a bubble of two letters is about 33 pt wide and no older, wider bubble stands here; inferred
at the leading edge beside the new bubble, where a received bubble would stand: the transcript's background (--mac-message-bubble-transcript-background), since the message is a sent one; inferred
under the status of the new bubble: the transcript's background (--mac-message-bubble-transcript-background), since one message was sent and it is the last; inferred
where Delivered stood under the first bubble: the transcript's background (--mac-message-bubble-transcript-background), since the status is now under the new bubble; inferred
centre of the Messages window's close button, red now that the click made the window key (--mac-color-window-close); inferred
centre of the Preferences window's close button, grey now that the window is behind (--mac-color-window-control-inactive); inferred

comparisons.name: send-dark
comparisons.description: Sending, Dark Aqua: as send-light in the scene of the Dark Aqua capture, where the message is sent a day after the others and so stands under a time of its own, 22 pt lower. The same eight pixels, and the same limits: which conversation, the text, the emptied field and the row are read by messages.browser.test.tsx.
